_meta.description: Runtime settings for the CoS pipeline. Copy to settings.json — settings.json is gitignored because included_root_folders carries real client folder names.
_meta.included_root_folders: Outlook top-level folders to read. Inbox / Drafts / Sent Items are the shared ones; every other entry is a per-client folder whose name must match a folder_name in clients.json.
_meta.invoice_sender: Mailbox that sends premium invoices. Inbound mail from this address moves an Invoice-stage work item to In Progress. See src/status_logic.py.
_meta.firm_name: Your firm's legal name. Used as the signature block on loss-run request drafts generated by the Loss Run skill.
